lines.text: The colour on your name means nothing past the wall. Out here your name means what you carry back.
Kestrel. You run convoys on my road and call it yours. We'll trade. We'll also take the third one back. That's the road.
Wall-folk. You found the Landing. That's the road. Sit; the fire's not for you but it doesn't know that.
Long sled from Landing to caverns. Bram calls the mouth a route kept off city maps. One journey in the record. It does not tell you who else uses the road.
Stake says the hum rises from below its sensor. Below. No distance on that word. Keep your feet on the ground you can measure.
Three viewpoints. Light in the fog. Ute offers the views; she does not name the light. No road off the plateau comes with that offer.
Named salvage recovered, says your record. Log gives a window before Directorate arrival. Who watches that clock? That's the road.
New-decanted. You smell of the vats. The ground smells it too; keep moving and it stops noticing.
The expedition has a record. That's the road. A record is not the whole ground.
Wall-folk. You found the Landing. That's the road. Sit; the fire's not for you but it doesn't know that.

barks.text: Sky's there whether you watch it or not. Watch it.
